releases.name: The Three Kingdoms of Shadows: Xuzhou
ASCEND.exe
releases.summary: ASCEND.exe is a retro-horror incremental: build nodes, chain combos, upgrade production. Descend into the facility's abandoned sections to learn why it never stopped expanding.

releases.name: The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain
releases.summary: The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain is an immersive live-action game mixing supernatural horror and puzzles. You play a passenger trapped on a creepy train and must survive. Focused on a blood-stained Passenger Survival Rules, you have to follow the rules, uncover their hidden secrets and escape.

releases.name: Twenty One Points
releases.summary: Twenty One Point is a strategy roguelike blending blackjack with deckbuilding. Beyond Hit and Stand, manage Mana to cast Awaken and Artifact skills that reshape your hand, deck, and fights. Choose a class, collect cards and artifacts, and battle through the map to forge your winning build.

releases.name: Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter
releases.summary:
From the makers of HANA, comes a life sim JRPG for Playdate about living in an apartment complex that's infested with monsters.

Use your sick baseball skills to exterminate monsters from your neighbors' apartments as a part-time devil hunter!!

Save up money for convenience store runs, and to pay off your overdue rent!!

Make some friends along the way!!

releases.name: Crown Jewels
releases.summary: Crown Jewels is a turn-based digital board game where 2-4 players roll custom dice, collect and steal jewels, use ally powers, and race to complete a crown before rivals!

releases.name: Hide & Seek
releases.summary: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

releases.name: TASMON: Taskbar Monsters
releases.summary: An idle RPG that lives in your taskbar. While you work, your monsters auto-battle and bring back eggs and loot. Collect 156 species, breed and awaken them, forge one-of-a-kind serial-stamped weapons, and shape every weekly update from the in-game suggestion box. Free to play.

releases.name: Chicken_Run
releases.summary: A great space escape action game where a chicken flees a farm, triggering global collapse. Navigate crumbling 2D terrains in real-time to survive. Experience a perilous escape centered on 'Freedom' and 'Responsibility,' where your quick reflexes are key to avoiding total doom.

releases.name: H.P Supernatural Event Archives
releases.summary: This is a text-based interactive adventure game with a suspenseful horror theme. Through different plot choices, you can collect various items, survive the attacks of indescribable creatures, and finally find the truth.

releases.name: Dark of the Depths
releases.summary: A first-person deep sea exploration game. Use only a torch to navigate through rusted structures, encountering both dangerous and harmless sea creatures. Uncover the mysteries of the trench, and experience the phobia-inducing atmosphere of the ocean floor.

releases.name: Molluscarium
releases.summary: Relax and collect over 500 unique molluscs in this cozy idle game. Watch larvae grow into stunning adults in real-time, customize vibrant aquatic habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from garden snails to deep-sea cephalopods.

releases.name: R.I.P.
releases.summary: A co-op horror game where you manipulate your own gravity to traverse a procedurally generated 3D maze filled with supernatural threats. Work alone or with your team to rescue the Inverted.

releases.name: Astral Blitz
releases.summary: Astral Blitz is a roguelite, twin stick shooter. Control your fighter ship and wreak devastation through the hordes of empire defenses. Create your own play style as you customize your ship to your needs, setting it up for brutal destruction, refined precision, or to become chaos incarnate!

releases.name: Hamayumishi ~ Night Parade of a Hundred Yokai ~
releases.summary: The Hamayumishi uses their intense powers of concentration and skills with the bow to protect the villages from the gamboling yokai! This is a side-scrolling twin-stick shooting game. While aiming, the game will slow down to allow you to line up your shot before letting it fly.

releases.name: No Need for Flowers
releases.summary: Dodge through colorful bullet patterns as you shoot down hordes of enemies in this arcade-style scrolling shooter bullet hell about magic dragon girls! Uncover a tragic story about acceptance as you overcome intense challenges that test both your skills and memory.

releases.name: Together in Forgotten Realms
releases.summary: Two souls, one destiny. Embark on a co-op adventure through a forgotten land, where teamwork and wit are the only way to navigate the wonders and dangers of a magical cave.

releases.name: Tide Of Tactics
releases.summary: Tide Of Tactics is a medieval turn-based tactics game. Choose a commander to play, each with their own unique unit and abilities, then go to battle on a grid-based battlefield. Use the terrain to your advantage, place traps on the ground, and build the right units to counter your enemy.

releases.name: The Eternal Woods
releases.summary: The Eternal Woods is a short, fast paced incremental about an adventurer trapped in a never ending Woods. Sharpen your axe, upgrade your skills and conquer the different Forests to escape the Woods!

releases.name: Miseria
releases.summary: Miseria is a dark fantasy idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.
